summary: Evotec SE filed a Form 6-K on April 24, 2026, announcing a CFO transition. CFO Paul Hitchin will step down on April 30, 2026, for personal reasons unrelated to the company, and will be succeeded by Claire Hinshelwood, effective May 1, 2026. No financial terms, board recommendation, or advisors were disclosed. The filing is a routine management change announcement; no special-situation transaction mechanics or regulatory clocks are implicated. Investors should monitor the new CFO's execution of Evotec's transformation plan for near- and mid-term profitability goals.
